Summary: Character is who you are when no one is watching, and God shapes it slowly through trials, obedience, and time. Scripture links suffering to endurance, endurance to character, and character to hope. The goal is not a polished reputation but a life that quietly resembles Christ.
RelatedPeople: Paul; Simon Peter; Joseph, Son of Jacob
RelatedEvents: Joseph Rises to Power in Egypt; The Temptation in the Wilderness
